length_field_contract.length_mm: Confirmed simple native rod axis / rectangular plate long edge only; null for processed rods.
length_field_contract.raw_cut_length_mm: Native straight-cylinder geometric blank only, no machining allowance. Null for all processed proxies.
length_field_contract.raw_length_proxy_mm: User-requested processed rod estimate, from sampled-boundary box (28 rods) or sampled-point diagonal (3 rods), never the loose API enclosure. Never manufacturing released.
length_field_contract.bbox_length_mm: Largest world AABB span, metadata only; can exceed trimmed part extent.
length_field_contract.diagonal_length_mm: Largest pair distance in sampled native boundary points, not a proven global extremum or rod axis.
length_field_contract.production_quantity: Not selected in this pilot; always null, not zero.
